correctness.rationale: Exact regenerative age mixture gives positional Gaussian kernels with conditional variances c t^3 and w^2 t^2. For Brownian heading, H_t=(Pe/(2M))t^2 e1+L1 O(t^(5/2)). Gaussian exponential expansion with uniform e and p controls all neglected terms O(s^(-2/3)) for zero velocity, O(1+|log s|) for Maxwell. Gamma-integral evaluation yields A, B, C, and polar integration proves cubic mixture and directional bias. The verification script independently computes three finite-age integral limits; finite tests do not establish the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: Natural and experimentally distinguishable restoration of velocity at reset determines different singular dimensions for a planar inertial active particle. The exact active angular-dipole coefficient and small-disk heading bias quantify persistence near the reset point; p^3 crossover is a meaningful sharp impurity scale distinguishing rare deterministic velocity resets from thermalized resets, not a routine numerical recomputation of global moments.
